introduction.title: What is OpenAI Agent Workflow?
introduction.content: OpenAI Agent Workflow represents a paradigm shift in artificial intelligence, enabling multiple AI agents to collaborate, reason, and execute complex tasks autonomously. Unlike traditional chatbots that respond to single queries, Agent Workflow allows AI to plan, execute, and adapt strategies across multiple steps and systems.
keyPoints: **Multi-Agent Orchestration**: Coordinate multiple specialized AI agents working together
**Autonomous Decision Making**: Agents can reason, plan, and execute without human intervention
**Tool Integration**: Seamless connection to APIs, databases, and enterprise systems
**Learning & Adaptation**: Agents improve performance over time based on outcomes
**Enterprise-Grade Security**: Built-in compliance and access controls

faq.question: What makes Agent Workflow different from ChatGPT?
faq.answer: While ChatGPT excels at conversational interactions, Agent Workflow enables AI to autonomously plan, execute multi-step tasks, integrate with external systems, and collaborate with other agents to achieve complex goals without human intervention.

faq.question: How secure is Agent Workflow for enterprise use?
faq.answer: Agent Workflow includes enterprise-grade security features including SOC 2 Type II compliance, end-to-end encryption, granular access controls, comprehensive audit logging, and data residency options. All agent actions are logged and can be monitored in real-time.

faq.question: Can I integrate Agent Workflow with my existing systems?
faq.answer: Yes! Agent Workflow supports integration with 100+ tools and services out of the box, including popular CRMs, databases, cloud platforms, and APIs. You can also create custom integrations using our SDK.

faq.question: What kind of tasks can agents handle?
faq.answer: Agents can handle a wide variety of tasks including data analysis, customer service, content creation, code review, financial analysis, marketing campaigns, and more. If a task can be broken down into logical steps and doesn't require human judgment, agents can likely automate it.

faq.question: How do I get started with Agent Workflow?
faq.answer: Getting started is easy! Sign up for a free developer account, follow our quickstart guide to create your first agent, and start automating tasks. We provide extensive documentation, tutorials, and sample code to help you succeed.

faq.question: What's the learning curve for implementing agents?
faq.answer: Basic agent implementation requires minimal coding knowledge - you can start with our no-code builder. For advanced use cases, Python or JavaScript experience is helpful. Most teams deploy their first working agent within a week.
